about: check:server-pipeline allowlist. Every entry names a file the heuristic matches that is NOT a copy of the Python-server request pipeline, with the reason. 'pending:' entries are copies still to migrate. The list only shrinks: a stale entry fails the check. See scripts/check-server-pipeline.ts.

app/(admin)/administration/compute/resil.reason: Admin lab that exercises the transport layer itself: its in-browser mock streams emit bare fixture lines (not server envelopes) and one scenario must throw on a torn line; its server scenarios go through requestRaw + parseNdjsonStream.

app/(dev)/demos/local-tools/_lib/useMatr.reason: Not the Python server: the matrx-local desktop engine on localhost.

app/(dev)/demos/local-tools/chat/page.de.reason: Not the Python server: streams from the matrx-local desktop engine on localhost.

app/(dev)/demos/tests/matrx-local/Downlo.reason: Not the Python server: the matrx-local desktop engine on localhost.

app/(dev)/demos/tests/matrx-local/page.d.reason: Not the Python server: the matrx-local desktop engine on localhost.

app/(dev)/demos/token-broker/page.dev.ts.reason: Not the Python server: reads a provider's (Anthropic) SSE through the token-broker gateway.

app/api/compute-targets/resolve/route.ts.reason: Not the Python server: calls the sandbox orchestrator; the server host appears only as a returned value.

app/api/mcp/oauth/callback/route.ts.reason: The raw fetch is the third-party MCP OAuth token endpoint; the server call builds its URL with buildMatrxRequestUrl and sends through persistMcpOAuthTokens (sendMatrxRequest).

components/admin/debug/CodeWorkspaceDebu.reason: Not the Python server: fetches Next /api/sandbox routes; the server base URL is only displayed.

features/code/adapters/SandboxProcessAda.reason: Not the Python server: parses the sandbox exec stream from the Next /api/sandbox route.

features/files/cache/service-worker/src/.reason: Service worker pass-through cache: re-issues the page's own requests, never builds a server URL.

features/files/media-client/client.ts.reason: pending: the fetch injected into @ai-matrx/files carries its own organization-admission gate and body sniff; move onto the core transport (createMatrxTransport) in the files package.

features/sharing/components/ShareModal.t.reason: Not the Python server: builds a share link on the app's own origin and calls a Next /api/sharing route.

features/window-panels/windows/ShareModa.reason: Not the Python server: builds a share link on the app's own origin and calls a Next /api/sharing route.

lib/diagnostics/stream-capture/install-f.reason: Diagnostics tap that observes every fetch body in the page for the Error Inspector; it parses nothing it acts on.

lib/local-engine/discovery.ts.reason: Not the Python server: discovers the matrx-local desktop engine on localhost ports.

lib/sandbox/active-binding.ts.reason: Not the Python server: calls Next /api/sandbox and /api/compute-targets routes.

../aidream/apps/shared/chat/src/agents/s.reason: Not the Python server: OAuth discovery against a third-party MCP server.
